provenance.source: County-level aggregates prepared by a data depositor from the full edit history of an online collaborative street map, plus public Census and ACS data. Files flagged (*) were pre-processed by the depositor; files flagged (**) were computed by the depositor from the map's full history files.
provenance.no_dictionary: There is no variable dictionary. Column meanings come only from column names, stored labels and the one-line file notes. The implementation manifest fixes every mapping you need.

quarterly.csv.deposit_note: county-quarter level contributions to the map (**)
quarterly.csv.format: tab-separated, header row, values double-quoted in most lines

keys.geoid: county FIPS stored as text without leading zero (4 digits for state codes 01-09)

quarterly.csv.column_types: all columns other than geoid and quarter are numeric counts or shares when parsed
quarterly.csv.coverage: 3112 distinct counties; 38 distinct quarter values from 2005q2 to 2014q4 (2005q1 and 2005q3 never appear); counties appear in between 3 and 36 quarters; there is no duplicate county-quarter
quarterly.csv.irregular_lines: 3111 lines inside the file repeat the header (quoted), so every column reads as text until they are removed; 2 lines have an empty quarter and contain header names as values in the last two columns
quarterly.csv.absent_rows: County-quarters not present in the file are not explained by the deposit notes

county_lookup.csv.deposit_note: treatment status by county, coded by the depositor from a published map of counties updated in an earlier government map revision

acs5year.dta.deposit_note: control variables from the American Community Survey 5-year data, years 2005-2011
acs5year.dta.coverage: 3223 distinct counties, 52 state codes, acsyear 2005 to 2011, no duplicate county-year
acs5year.dta.label_note: SE_T codes are Social Explorer ACS table codes as stored in the file

timing.xlsx.deposit_note: government data on the scheduled timing of county map updates, obtained by personal communication
timing.xlsx.format: Excel, a single sheet; read the first sheet
timing.xlsx.missing: Sch SB Delivery blank in 4 rows, SB Selected in 3, Thread in 5

boundary-counties.csv.format: comma-separated, header row; second header has a leading space

distance.csv.deposit_note: driving distance between origin and destination address pairs from an open-source router (osrm_distance) and a commercial map service (ggl_distance), queried in 2017

placebo_draws.csv.note: Supplied for the placebo analyses; built from county keys only.

development_data: The data/ folder you receive is synthetic: same file names, columns and formats, random values, and fewer counties. Row counts and coverage numbers in this registry describe the real files.
other_files: The deposit holds further files that no analysis uses; they are not described here.
